name: whisper-medium-komixv2
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-medium (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of openai/whisper-medium, not a new base model: same config.json, 0.764B parameters against the base record's 0.769B - a rounding or label difference, not extra weights, and the tensor set is the base's. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. No licence tag on the repo, repo created 2025-03-02. The evaluation table is inherited from rtzr/Awesome-Korean-Speech-Recognition and holds a row for every whisper size; base = the whisper_medium row of that same table.
